pkgmetadata.longdescription: Anthropic's official Claude desktop application, repacked from the Debian package they publish at downloads.claude.ai. It bundles its own Electron runtime, the MCP host, and the QEMU-backed sandbox Cowork runs agent sessions in. The Debian-only parts of the package (apt repository registration, the AppArmor userns profile and the lintian overrides) are dropped.

use.flag: Use dev-libs/libayatana-appindicator for the system tray icon
Install the firmware compatibility symlinks and pull in the QEMU stack that the Cowork agent sandbox needs
Register the GNOME Shell search provider for Claude Code sessions (needs dev-libs/gjs)
